title: Living together
tagline: Shared costs fair and simple, both of you protected, and the paperwork right whether you marry or not.
trigger: A partner starts paying part of the rent, or wedding costs appear.

steps.title: A joint account for shared costs
steps.description: Rent, groceries and bills from one joint account; each of you keeps your own account too.
steps.why: Your partner gets their own access; your personal accounts stay private.
steps.result: Joint account ready; your partner is invited to co-sign.

steps.title: Who pays what
steps.description: A fair split of fixed costs, in proportion to income or fifty-fifty, worked out from your own payments.
steps.why: Nothing is shared with your partner unless you send it.
steps.result: Shared budget proposal ready to discuss together.

steps.title: Cohabitation or marriage: the paperwork
steps.description: A notary explains legal cohabitation, a cohabitation contract or a marriage settlement, and drafts the one you choose.
steps.why: The notary only receives your name, e-mail and family situation.

win.customer: Both partners protected if life changes

steps.result: Notary appointment set to go through the options.

steps.title: Protect each other
steps.description: Family liability insurance for the household and life insurance so each partner can keep the home.
steps.why: Unmarried partners don't automatically inherit from each other.
steps.result: Family insurance updated to cover both of you.

steps.title: One home insurance instead of two
steps.description: Merge your two home or tenant policies into one for the shared address.
steps.why: Two policies for one home means paying twice.
steps.result: Home insurance merged for your shared address.
